snippet.title: Bengaluru startup can turn toilet water in drinkable water - Boson White Water
snippet.description: Bengaluru-based Boson White Water is giving a second life to waste water. The startup transforms sewage treatment plant (STP) water into high-quality usable and potable H2O. They are creating a closed-loop system that reduces reliance on water tankers and promotes sustainable water management. In cities like Bengaluru hundreds of tankers worth of water is being saved every day with the use of this innovation. Boson White Water uses AI and IoT to maintain the quality of the water which is being recycled by them.

snippet.title: The AFP says there was no prior warning about alleged attack on Haines
snippet.description:
The Victoria Police chief commissioner and the Australian Federal Police (AFP) commissioner told a press conference this morning they have not ruled out laying further charges, including attempted murder, over the alleged attack on independent MP Helen Haines.

Victoria Police chief commissioner Mike Bush said Brendan Nugent, 43, has been charged with dangerous driving causing serious injury, intentionally causing serious injury and causing harm to a Commonwealth public official.

Australian Federal Police commissioner Krissy Barrett said the AFP had no forewarning about any imminent threat to Haines, in response to a question raised about Nugent's previous social media posts.

"What I can say is we didn't have any specific intelligence that would have indicated something as atrocious as happened on Monday afternoon," she said.

Asked about the level of protection afforded to federal MPs and what it would take for each to have a protection detail, she said it would take an "incredible amount of resourcing".

Haines, 65, remains in hospital in a critical but stable condition.
